einzeiler: Countdown of the top trending songs for the week of December 11th.
kurzfassung: This episode counts down the top trending songs on iHeartRadio for the week of December 11th. Paul Russell is at number five with Lil Boo Thang, followed by Miley Cyrus at number four. Taylor Swift claims the third spot, Doja Cat is at number two, and Tate McRae takes the number one position with Greedy.
stichpunkte: Paul Russell enters at number five with Lil Boo Thang
Miley Cyrus slides back to number four with Used to Be Young
Taylor Swift rises to number three with Cruel Summer after seven weeks at number one
Doja Cat drops to the second spot with Paint the Town Red
Tate McRae takes the number one position with Greedy
